blocking_classes: ambient llama.cpp environment bypasses the default-off arm
direct I/O can silently fall back to buffered reads and violate the single-weight-footprint bound
no authoritative five-block matched A/B runner and fixed scorer

high.evidence: The launcher omits --no-direct-io in the OFF arm while the pinned parser accepts LLAMA_ARG_DIO before CLI parsing, so ambient LLAMA_ARG_DIO=1 can enable the diagnostic without its flag or log.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Execute command construction/parser tests across ambient DIO variables; OFF must pass the exact negative argument and ON must be the only enabling path.
high.reproduction_instructions: Set DSV4_DIRECT_IO=0 and LLAMA_ARG_DIO=1 against an argv/effective-option recorder; observe use_direct_io=true without an explicit negative CLI option.

high.affected_gate: host stability, direct-arm identity, exact replay, and evidence validity
high.evidence: The pinned source falls back on O_DIRECT open failure and EFAULT/EINVAL reads. Under --no-mmap the requested flag can remain true after fallback, allowing page-cache growth beside resident weights. A partial-read-then-fallback path can also restart at the wrong destination and corrupt data.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Add a mandatory-direct mode with per-shard effective attestation and fault-injection tests for every open/read/partial-read fallback; all injected failures must stop cleanly before continued upload.
high.reproduction_instructions: Inject O_DIRECT open failure per shard and EFAULT/EINVAL before and after a positive short read; observe buffered continuation and requested/effective mode ambiguity.

high.affected_gate: matched cold-load measurement and anti-cheating evidence authority
high.evidence: The plan has three trials rather than five ABBA/BAAB blocks and no public-randomness schedule, fixed scorer, confidence-bound relative metric, or manifest/raw/summary validator. Absolute thresholds can pass a regression.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: RED-test a five-block randomized runner/scorer that binds all inputs, externally times launch-to-health, attests actual direct descriptors, emits manifest/raw/summary, computes a relative confidence bound, and rejects malformed evidence.
high.reproduction_instructions: Construct slower-than-stock candidate rows below the absolute limits or omit/duplicate/stale an arm; candidate 1 has no fixed scorer capable of rejecting them.

medium.evidence: Each host buffer is allocated at buffer_size, its base is rounded upward, and a full buffer_size read may then exceed the allocation if the backend base lacks filesystem-block alignment.
medium.proposed_acceptance_test: Allocate alignment headroom or assert alignment, then guard-test the maximally misaligned base and update the aggregate bound.
medium.reproduction_instructions: Return a host-buffer base misaligned by one byte under a guarded backend and perform a full-size aligned read; inspect the guard boundary.

high.evidence: The OFF arm emits no negative CLI argument, so the pinned parser's LLAMA_ARG_DIO environment path can enable direct I/O while DSV4_DIRECT_IO is zero.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Test actual argv/effective parsing with ambient positive and negative DIO variables; OFF must remain explicitly disabled.
high.reproduction_instructions: Launch an argv-recording mock with DSV4_DIRECT_IO=0 and LLAMA_ARG_DIO=1 and inspect the effective option.

high.affected_gate: direct-arm identity, performance validity, and UMA safety
high.evidence: O_DIRECT open/read failures silently become buffered reads, so the arm can be mislabeled and can repopulate a second weight-sized page-cache footprint before the watchdog reacts.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: A required-direct arm must fail immediately on every open/read fallback, attest each shard's descriptor mode, and pass injected-failure cleanup/safety tests.
high.reproduction_instructions: Inject open failure and EINVAL/EFAULT in separate shards and observe successful buffered continuation without a disqualifying receipt.

high.evidence: No runner or scorer implements five fresh-server ABBA/BAAB blocks, public randomness, confidence intervals, hash binding, containment, or mutation-tested terminal validation.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Commit a RED-tested five-block runner and fixed scorer with fresh cgroups, stable-memory preflight, swap/Xid/identity sampling, exact artifacts, and malformed-evidence mutations before any model load.
high.reproduction_instructions: Try to produce an authoritative verdict using only candidate-1 files; the executable measurement and validation path is absent.

medium.evidence: POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED is advisory and the plan records neither post-eviction residency nor physical read bytes.
medium.proposed_acceptance_test: Record external physical-read counters and a post-eviction cache observation; reject insufficient or unequal cold-read coverage.
medium.reproduction_instructions: Prepopulate shard pages, execute fadvise, and compare page residency and physical reads during the stock load.
